name: Rust
description: Rust is a systems programming language focused on safety, speed, and concurrency without a garbage collector. It powers everything from embedded devices to cloud infrastructure.

items.title: The Rust Programming Language (The Book)
items.description: The official introductory bible covering ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, and concurrency.

items.title: Rust by Example
items.description: Runnable code snippets illustrating Rust concepts and standard library features.

items.title: Comprehensive Rust (Google)
items.description: A multi-day course by Google covering Rust fundamentals, Android, and embedded systems.

items.title: Rust Documentation Hub
items.description: All official language docs, library specs, compiler guides, and edition notes.

items.title: The Rust Reference
items.description: The formal specification of Rust syntax, grammar, semantics, and memory model.

items.title: The Rustonomicon
items.description: The advanced guide exploring unsafe Rust, low-level memory, and FFI.

items.title: Rust Standard Library Docs
items.description: Deep API documentation for all built-in primitives, traits, and modules.

items.title: Rustlings

items.title: freeCodeCamp — Rust Course
items.description: A project-based course covering foundational and intermediate Rust concepts.
